name: ambient-context-mcp
description: Expose local Windows ambient context (presence, foreground app category, battery, power events, system load, long-session detection) as privacy-classified MCP tools. All data stays on 127.0.0.1; user opt-in is required for medium/high sensitivity context.
long_description: Ambient Context MCP is a Windows tray-resident process that publishes the user's local ambient context to MCP clients (Claude Code, Claude Desktop, etc.) via Streamable HTTP on loopback. Sensitivity is classified per-path and medium/high data is gated behind explicit opt-in toggles in the tray UI. This MCPB bundle ships a thin stdio adapter that connects Claude Desktop to the locally-running tray; the tray must be installed and running for the tools to respond.

tools.name: ambient_context_get_states
tools.description: Returns the latest ambient context states filtered by both the user's transmission policy and the client-supplied scope.

tools.name: ambient_context_poll_events
tools.description: Returns ambient context transition events (idle/return, AC connect/disconnect, foreground app changes) since the client's stored cursor.

tools.name: ambient_context_get_policy
tools.description: Returns the privacy classification table and effective transmission policy. Does not include sensitive context values.
